platform: Microsoft Windows 11 desktop / Windows App SDK design target

source_policy.preferred_native_primitive: SymbolIcon when enum member exists; FontIcon via SymbolThemeFontFamily only for frozen glyph absent from Symbol enum

external_guidance.source: Microsoft Learn — Segoe Fluent Icons font
external_guidance.finding: Windows 11 recommends Segoe Fluent Icons; FontIcon/SymbolIcon may use system font; crisp reference sizes include 16,20,24.

external_guidance.source: Microsoft Learn — Icons in Windows apps
external_guidance.finding: System icon fonts are the common Windows-app icon path; SymbolThemeFontFamily resolves the default system icon family.
Symbol enum exposes Back/Cancel/More/Setting/Find/Play/Pause and binds through SymbolThemeFontFamily; Windows App SDK 1.5+ uses current glyph codes.

verbs.note: E711 is retained from FICON-01 as the conventional X carrier; accessible name supplies Close semantics.
Real product accessible name must describe the disclosed target/context.

frozen_constraints: FICON-01 F1 Native Quiet Carrier treatment unchanged
focus ring remains independent from icon glyph
selection witness remains independent from icon glyph
no Threshold K geometry inside functional icons
no font/SVG binary committed as shipping asset
non_authority: No production token API or package decision.
